controls.title: BASIC CONTROLS
controls.subtitle: Use these shortcuts to move around and interact with the world.

professorLines.1: Hello there! Welcome to the world of POKéMON!
professorLines.2: My name is PROF. ELM. People call me the POKéMON PROF!
professorLines.3: This world is inhabited by creatures we call POKéMON.
professorLines.4: In truth, this is my portfolio — an interactive world built with Three.js.
professorLines.5: Explore freely and you will find projects, tech, and a bit of my journey as a developer.

pokemonLines.1: This is what we call a POKéMON.
pokemonLines.2: Cute, right? Some people keep them as pets. Others use them for battles.
pokemonLines.3: As for myself... I study POKéMON as a profession.

opening.genderPrompt: Are you a boy? Or are you a girl?
opening.namePrompt: Let's begin with your name. What is it?
opening.readyLine: All right, {name}! Your very own POKéMON adventure is about to unfold!

dialog1.1: Hello! Welcome to my portfolio! My name is Victor, I have been a web developer for 3 years.
dialog1.2: In reality, this is not exactly a game...
dialog1.3: It is an experience created with Three.js, inspired by the classic Pokémon games for the Nintendo DS.
dialog1.4: By exploring this world, you will find projects, technologies, and a bit of my journey as a developer.
dialog1.5: Oh, and a warning! This adventure is still under development. Therefore, new areas, projects, and features
dialog1.6: are being added gradually, so it's worth coming back from time to time to see the news!

dialog1.1: Hello, did you know that you can choose which Pokémon will follow you around?
dialog1.2: Just press the 'x' button, go to the Pokémon menu, and put first the Pokémon you want to follow you!
If you've been here before, this is the place to check out everything that has changed since the last update.
dialog1.3: You know, I spent some time recording the changes...
dialog1.5: •Now you can choose which Pokémon accompanies the player.
dialog1.6: •Performance improvements and shaders based on the user's hardware.
dialog1.8: •Addition of 3D models of trees and forest layout.
dialog1.9: •Update of the map layout and scenery (fences, streets, and sea).
dialog1.11: •3D models of structures and construction of the city area.
dialog1.12: •Change in how the camera behaves, smoothing the transition and user movements.
dialog1.13: Well, for now that's it, come here from time to time. Whenever there are news, I update this wall!
